messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: prior for likert items parameters
parts:
Hi there

I have a data set based on likert items. when i analysis my data by graded model in "mirt",  item's b are extremely high, since the item slopes are very low. could any one help me to solve this problem? for example by defining prior for item's d1, d2 .... any help? specifically how can i define prior for "d" parameters in likert items?

cheers

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: prior for likert items parameters
parts:
Do you have any prior information as to what these d's should be a priori? If no, then a Bayesian solution to the problem may not be justifiable. 

Phil

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: prior for likert items parameters
parts:
I certainly would report them as is. The model is likely well fitted despite the fact that the difficulty parameters are large (all they tell you is the theta location where the response curves inflect). The estimated intercept parameters are probably stable, and will be stable even when the slopes/discrimination  are equal to 0. HTH.

Phil
